semantic.justification: Native ordered content sequence parsing and extension-first lookup plus actual SAX writer metadata output, including source whitespace and strict relation attribute names. Ports only the consumed XML/package contract; native UNO services, general storage hierarchy, encrypted/ZIP64 packages, XLSB RecordParser and complete application document filters are outside this prerequisite. Strings/byte arrays and Promises bind host XML/ZIP transport; whole-module parity remains unverified. V4DQJW adds original ordered relationship-sequence reading: qualified root/child depth, required Id only, optional fields in Id/Type/Target/TargetMode order, duplicate preservation and ignored text. Writer uses this original XRelationshipAccess contract rather than oox::RelationsFragment admission.
